text: It is necessary for him to have a mind ready to turn itself accordingly as the winds and variations of fortune force it, yet... not to diverge from the good if he can avoid doing so, but, if compelled, then to know how to set about it.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XVIII, Concerning the way in which princes should keep faith
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
